cases.title: Real CLI validates and projects a multilingual L1 candidate
cases.requirement: The explicit CLI handles Chinese, Japanese, currency symbols, emoji, spaces, canonical UTF-8, and human-readable projection.
cases.expected: validate and project succeed and create one immutable external sidecar bundle

cases.title: Traceability and integrity violations fail closed
cases.requirement: Silent loss, missing dual coverage, unknown references, locator drift, omissions overlapping represented content, source tampering, and result tampering are rejected.
cases.expected: all invalid candidates fail before sidecar persistence

cases.title: Candidate identity binds the implementation file set
cases.requirement: The candidate SHA-256 is computed from the ordered path and SHA-256 list of all seven declared implementation files.
cases.runner: PowerShell Get-FileHash SHA256 over the seven declared implementation files

cases.title: Append-only sidecar boundary preserves summary-v1
cases.requirement: Identical reruns are idempotent, conflicting bytes cannot replace a sidecar, archive-root output is rejected, and summary-v1 remains unchanged.
cases.expected: summary-v1 hash is unchanged and overwrite or archive-root attempts fail closed

cases.title: One-shot worker uses bounded prompt, schema, and offline candidate route
cases.requirement: The worker invokes one read-only schema-constrained model call when authorized and accepts an offline candidate without a model call.
cases.expected: stubbed worker and dry-run pass; real archive content is not sent without explicit authorization

cases.title: Authorized real archive generation and human A/B review
cases.requirement: Generate summary-v2 from the explicitly authorized job-000493, validate the immutable sidecar, preserve summary-v1, and perform semantic comparison rather than relying on structural counts.
cases.runner: scripts/summary_v2_worker.py l1 plus scripts/memory_summary_v2.py validate-sidecar and compare
cases.expected: A valid external sidecar is created; human review records both recovered detail and any remaining semantic omission before activation.

historical_failures.description: Changing established summary records can alter immutable federation identities, so summary-v2 remains a separate sidecar.
Broad prose summaries can become too vague to explain decisions or locate exact source evidence.
Windows command paths and multilingual records require explicit UTF-8 handling.
Representing every source message does not prove that every durable fact, threshold, limitation, or open question survived compression.
